title: AAP Bathinda MLA skips roadshow by Mann & Kejriwal, says ‘not invited’
summary: AAP's Bathinda MLA did not participate in a roadshow by Mann and Kejriwal, claiming he was not invited to the event.
digest: The Aam Aadmi Party's Member of Legislative Assembly representing Bathinda did not attend a roadshow organised by party leaders Mann and Arvind Kejriwal. When asked about his absence, the MLA stated that he had not received an invitation to the event. No further details about the roadshow's date, location, or purpose were provided in the available information.
id: aap bathinda mla skips roadshow by mann kejriwal says not invite

title: Bathinda hottest at 43.8°C as heatwave returns, rain relief right behind
summary: Bathinda recorded its highest temperature at 43.8°C as a heatwave grips the region, though rainfall is expected soon to provide relief.
digest: Bathinda district experienced extreme heat conditions with the temperature reaching 43.8°C, marking the highest recorded temperature during the current heatwave. The scorching conditions have affected the region significantly. However, meteorological forecasts indicate that relief is on the way, with rainfall expected in the coming days to ease the heatwave conditions and provide respite to residents.
